title: Metadevices that compute: mathematical foundations and experimental implementations for neuromorphic nanophotonics
abstract: Wave-based analog computing has re-emerged as a compelling alternative to digital electronics for specific linear-algebraic and machine-learning workloads, promising massively parallel, high-bandwidth, and energy-efficient information processing. Metamaterials, metasurfaces, and integrated metastructures (collectively, metadevices) now perform mathematical operations, solve integral and differential equations, multiply matrices, and implement trainable photonic neural networks directly in the wave domain. This focused review consolidates the mathematical foundations that underpin such devices, i.e., the mapping between linear operators and wave scattering, the feedback architectures that realize equation inversion, and the inverse-design and scientific machine-learning toolchains that make their synthesis and training tractable, and connects them to the rapidly growing body of experimental demonstrations, from free-space diffractive processors to reconfigurable guided-wave metastructures. We conclude with open problems and opportunities for this emerging neuromorphic nanophotonics ecosystem.

summaries.en: The paper reviews the mathematical and experimental foundations of “metadevices” in neuromorphic nanophotonics that use wave-based operations to perform linear-algebra tasks—such as equation solving, matrix multiplication, and trainable photonic neural networks—via operator–scattering mappings, feedback architectures, and inverse-design/scientific ML toolchains, ending with key open challenges and opportunities.
summaries.zh: 本文综述了神经形态纳米光子学中“元器件（metadevices）”的数学与实验基础：利用波动式模拟计算在波域直接完成线性代数任务（如方程求解、矩阵乘法和可训练的光子神经网络），通过算子—散射映射、实现方程反演的反馈结构以及逆设计/科学机器学习工具链来支撑，并结合从自由空间衍射处理器到可重构波导式超结构的快速增长实验进展，最后提出该新兴生态的开放问题与机会。

title: Comparison of melanin subtypes using pump-probe microscopy
abstract: Pump-probe microscopy (PPM) is used to probe excited state dynamics of endogenous chromophores to generate contrast that is unavailable in traditional forms of microscopy. Here we apply PPM to characterize melanin, a pigment central to photoprotection, skin and eye pigmentation, and melanoma pathogenesis. Melanin is notoriously difficult to analyze due to its structural and chemical complexity. We imaged melanin from six different lesion categories: cutaneous nevi, lentigo, cutaneous malignant melanoma, conjunctival melanocytic lesions, vulvar melanocytic lesions, and a murine melanoma model, across 21 independent biological samples and 109 regions of interest. Using model fitting, adapted phasor analysis, and support vector machine classification, we characterize and quantify excited-state dynamics as a surrogate for chemical and structural heterogeneity. Heterogeneity of melanin separates cutaneous from non-cutaneous lesions, but is not correlated with malignancy. Benign lentigo is the most heterogeneous population in the dataset, exceeding cutaneous malignant melanoma, while conjunctival lesions are the most homogeneous despite receiving direct solar exposure. Classification on full transient absorption curves separates most subtypes well above the six-class chance level. These findings demonstrate the ability of PPM to reveal subtle differences in melanin photophysics across diverse tissue environments, with implications for optical tissue classification and the understanding of melanoma pathogenesis.

summaries.en: The paper uses pump-probe microscopy with model fitting, adapted phasor analysis, and support vector machine classification to quantify melanin excited-state dynamics across multiple lesion categories and shows that melanin heterogeneity distinguishes cutaneous from non-cutaneous lesions but does not correlate with malignancy, while transient-absorption–based classification can separate most melanin subtypes.
summaries.zh: 论文利用泵浦-探测显微镜结合模型拟合、改进的相量分析和支持向量机分类，定量比较多种病灶类型中黑色素的激发态动力学，发现黑色素异质性可区分皮肤来源与非皮肤来源病灶但与恶性程度不相关，而基于瞬态吸收曲线的分类能够将大多数黑色素亚型有效区分开来。

title: Microscopic Theory of Spin-Orbit Interactions of Light
abstract: Optical spin-orbit interactions (SOI), demonstrated experimentally in optical cavities, enable the polarization degrees of freedom of light to be described and controlled as an effective pseudospin, providing a foundation for spintronic-like control of light and the development of next-generation optical technologies. However, prior works describe this emergent effect using phenomenological models that fail to uncover its microscopic quantum origins, and as a result, a rigorous connection between material electronic structure and the optical SOI remains elusive. In this work, we address this fundamental challenge by developing a microscopic quantum theory starting from the non-relativistic quantum electrodynamical (QED) description of light-matter interactions. We show that this effect arises from virtual interactions between confined photons and material excitations. Crucially, our theoretical framework provides microscopic material-design principles for tuning the distinct components of optical SOI, which include the optical birefringence, photonic self-energies, TE-TM splitting, and optical Zeeman splitting, enabling precise engineering of effective magnetic fields, diabolical points, and pseudospin textures. We anticipate that the predictive capability of our microscopic theory will enable systematic screening and design of material systems for photonic spintronics and optical technologies.

summaries.en: The paper presents a microscopic quantum theory of optical spin-orbit interactions derived from non-relativistic QED, showing they originate from virtual coupling between confined photons and material excitations and yielding material-design principles to tune birefringence, self-energies, TE–TM splitting, and Zeeman splitting for engineered effective magnetic fields and pseudospin textures relevant to photonic spintronics.
summaries.zh: 本文基于非相对论量子电动力学（QED）建立光与物质相互作用的微观量子理论，表明光学自旋-轨道相互作用源于受限光子与材料激发之间的虚拟耦合，并给出可调谐双折射、光子自能、TE–TM 分裂和光学塞曼分裂等组成分量的材料设计原则，从而实现可工程化的等效磁场、狄亚波点与类自旋纹理，为光子自旋电子学与光学技术的系统筛选与设计提供预测能力。

title: From proof of concept to practice: the next decade of artificial intelligence in metasurface photonics
abstract: Over the past decade, artificial intelligence has learned to predict electromagnetic responses rapidly and generate high-performance metasurface designs. However, one question remains open: compared with conventional design workflows that contain no learned model, has it made the complete design workflow faster, and are the resulting devices better? We argue that the answer depends on the task. Reading 100 highly cited optical studies in depth, we distinguish the design tasks in which artificial intelligence is irreplaceable, clearly advantageous, or without clear advantage. In our view, the key to the next decade is not more successes in isolated tasks but making each success a foundation for the field, through shifts such as shared data, trained models, and physics written into learning. Whether artificial intelligence leaves lasting value in this field will depend on whether its benefits can be verified, its methods transferred, and its designs corrected by experiment.

summaries.en: By reviewing 100 influential optical studies, the paper argues that AI-driven metasurface design speeds and quality gains depend on the specific task, and that the next decade’s impact will hinge on scalable evidence, transferable methods, and physics-informed, experimentally validated workflows built from shared data and trained models rather than isolated wins.
summaries.zh: 通过对100篇高被引光学研究的深入阅读，论文认为AI驱动的超表面设计在加速与提升质量方面取决于具体任务，而未来十年的真正影响在于可验证的成效、可迁移的方法以及基于共享数据与训练模型、并将物理融入学习的工作流，同时还需经实验纠正与验证。

title: Dual-rate optical frequency comb based on a cylindrical microresonator with a nanoscale radius variation
abstract: We theoretically find that a cylindrical microresonator with nanoscale radius variation can be a source of coherent microcombs with two repetition rates, independently controlled by the device geometry. This phenomenon arises from the formation of two-dimensional axial-azimuthal dissipative Kerr solitons (2D DKS), which we discovered through numerical simulations of the nonlinearly coupled Lugiato-Lefever equations with realistic microresonator device parameters. We demonstrate that, despite the variation in the dispersion characteristics of azimuthal modes at different axial numbers, the spontaneous synchronization mechanism leads to a unified soliton repetition rate. We consider near-parabolic variations in the radius of a cylindrical resonator, compatible with the surface nanoscale axial photonics (SNAP) platform. In our example, we generate 2D DKS with an azimuthal rate of approximately 329 GHz and an axial rate of 6 GHz, which can be adjusted on demand by selecting the appropriate resonator geometry, thereby promising compact sources of frequency combs operating simultaneously across different frequency scales.

summaries.en: The paper theoretically shows that a cylindrical microresonator with nanoscale radius variation can generate coherent optical microcombs with two independently tunable repetition rates via 2D dissipative Kerr solitons, supported by simulations of coupled Lugiato-Lefever dynamics and a spontaneous synchronization mechanism yielding a unified soliton rate, with a SNAP-compatible near-parabolic geometry producing example azimuthal and axial rates of ~329 GHz and 6 GHz.
summaries.zh: 论文理论上表明，具有纳米尺度半径起伏的圆柱微谐振器可通过二维耗散克尔孤子产生具有两个可独立调控重复率的相干光学微梳，并通过对耦合的Lugiato-Lefever方程进行数值模拟及自发同步机制证明尽管不同轴向模的色散特性会变化，孤子会被同步到统一的重复率；在与SNAP平台兼容的近抛物线几何中，示例可获得约329 GHz的方位速率和6 GHz的轴向速率，且可通过选择合适器件几何按需调节。

title: Ultraviolet Raman spectroscopy using multimode aluminum oxide waveguides
abstract: Waveguide-based Raman spectroscopy offers a route toward compact and integrated photonic sensors. While most waveguide Raman platforms operate in the near-infrared, extending excitation toward the visible and ultraviolet is attractive because shorter excitation wavelengths can provide substantially stronger Raman scattering and access to resonance-enhanced molecular responses. This transition, however, places greater demands on the photonic material because of optical loss, absorption and waveguide-generated spectral background. Here, we investigate aluminum oxide ($Al_2O_3$) waveguides as a low-background platform for Raman spectroscopy at 532 nm and 325 nm using a back-collected excitation and detection geometry. At 532 nm, after normalization to the incident excitation power-time product, the measured $Al_2O_3$ background was more than two orders of magnitude lower than that of $Si_3N_4$. Under 325 nm excitation, the waveguides maintained a weak and reproducible spectral background across the investigated widths. Using immersion oil as a model analyte deposited over the waveguide surface, we demonstrate that analyte-specific Raman fingerprints can be recovered above the waveguide background at both wavelengths. Signal-to-background ratio and spectral contrast were used to quantify analyte visibility relative to the waveguide background, and both metrics consistently confirmed clear detection of the analyte bands. These results demonstrate that $Al_2O_3$ combines low measured spectral background with operation from the visible into the ultraviolet, providing a promising route toward integrated Raman spectroscopy at shorter excitation wavelengths.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that low-background aluminum oxide (Al2O3) multimode waveguides enable integrated Raman spectroscopy at 532 nm and 325 nm, recovering analyte-specific Raman fingerprints with high signal-to-background contrast despite ultraviolet demands on material loss and background.
summaries.zh: 论文表明低背景的氧化铝（Al2O3）多模波导可实现532 nm和325 nm的集成拉曼光谱，并在考虑紫外条件下材料损耗与背景的挑战下，仍能恢复特异性拉曼指纹且实现可靠的信噪比/背景对比度。

title: Focusing through coupled multimode fibers for miniaturized single-atom tweezer arrays
abstract: Real-world deployment of quantum technologies requires systems in low SWaP-C packages. Quantum platforms based on ultracold atoms typically trap and control atoms with optical tweezers using light focused through bulky objective lenses, which are costly and sensitive to misalignment. Multimode fibers (MMFs) offer a compact route to focusing light, but their use in forming optical tweezers for cold atoms has been limited to a single fiber. Here we use a 2x1 MMF fused coupler to obtain two independent control paths sharing a common distal facet. We form near-diffraction-limited tweezers through each channel, suppress interference by applying a small frequency offset between the channels, and demonstrate that the tweezer separation is insensitive to misalignment of the input coupling. This work provides a route to reconfigurable single-atom arrays in low SWaP-C environments.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates a compact 2x1 multimode-fiber fused coupler that creates two independent, near-diffraction-limited single-atom tweezer channels sharing one distal facet while suppressing cross-interference with a small frequency offset and showing tweezer spacing is robust against input misalignment, enabling reconfigurable low-SWaP-C single-atom arrays.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并验证了一种2x1多模光纤熔接耦合器，在同一个远端端面上获得两条独立的近衍射极限单原子光镊通道，通过在通道间施加小频率偏移来抑制干涉，并证明光镊间距对输入耦合的失准不敏感，从而实现低SWaP-C环境中的可重构单原子阵列。

title: Field-resolved observation and quantification of the instantaneous Kerr response in semiconductors
abstract: The optical Kerr effect, whereby the refractive index of a material changes with light intensity, underpins nonlinear photonics and emerging mid-infrared technologies. Accurate determination of the nonlinear refractive index is therefore essential, yet conventional intensity-based techniques infer the nonlinear phase shift indirectly from changes in beam propagation or optical spectra. Moreover, methods such as the $z$-scan cannot resolve the temporal evolution of the nonlinear response, making it difficult to distinguish instantaneous Kerr nonlinearities from delayed contributions, including free-carrier effects. Here, we investigate the nonlinear optical response of germanium at $5 \mu\mathrm{m}$ using field-resolved degenerate pump-probe spectroscopy. By measuring the transmitted probe electric field as a function of pump-probe delay, we directly retrieve the pump-induced phase shift and its temporal evolution while retaining sensitivity to changes in absorption. We observe cross-phase modulation that follows the pump intensity envelope and vanishes when the pump and probe no longer overlap, consistent with an instantaneous Kerr response. The phase shift scales linearly with pump intensity, yielding a nonlinear refractive index of $n_2=(0.87\pm0.16)\times10^{-17} \mathrm{m}^2/\mathrm{W}$. Our results establish the instantaneous Kerr effect as the dominant contribution to the measured nonlinear phase shift under our experimental conditions and demonstrate field-resolved pump-probe spectroscopy as a direct, time-resolved method for determining the nonlinear refractive index and distinguishing instantaneous from delayed optical responses.

title: A Universal Approach to Hydrodynamics in Higher Dimensions via Tensor Networks
abstract: Extracting late-time hydrodynamic transport properties directly from microscopic quantum models, especially in dimensions beyond one, is believed to be classically intractable. This owes, in part, to the extensive growth of entanglement in higher dimensions and often a mismatch between geometric and tensor network locality. Here, we extend the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to accurately and quantitatively predict high-temperature transport coefficients (e.g. diffusion constants) in up to three dimensions. Additionally, we demonstrate the ability to capture the slow crossover dynamics characteristic of weakly broken integrability. The intuition underlying our approach is to preserve the geometrically local information crucial for hydrodynamics throughout the time evolution, despite using a one-dimensional matrix product state ansatz for higher-dimensional calculations. Our work pushes the boundary of classical computability and opens the door to benchmarking the high-temperature, late-time dynamics of generic quantum simulators.

summaries.en: The paper extends the Density Matrix Truncation (DMT) algorithm to use a one-dimensional tensor-network ansatz while preserving geometrically local information, enabling accurate classical prediction of high-temperature hydrodynamic transport coefficients and weakly broken integrability crossover dynamics in up to three dimensions.
summaries.zh: 该论文将密度矩阵截断（DMT）算法扩展为在更高维计算中尽管使用一维张量网络模型，却通过保持几何局域信息来实现对最高温度下流体力学输运系数以及弱破缺可积性慢速跨越动力学的准确经典预测（最高到三维）。

title: Fock-space delocalization and its control in scarred-vs-ergodic dynamics
abstract: Quantum many-body scarred dynamics in Rydberg-atom arrays is characterized by revivals, in which the system repeatedly returns to its initial state despite its many-body complexity. But how extensively does the wave function explore the space of allowed configurations between revivals? We address this question by quantifying the fraction of configurations occupied during PXP dynamics initialized from the paradigmatic polarized and Néel states, which respectively exhibit thermalizing and scarred dynamics. Despite their striking revivals, dynamics from the Néel state spreads over exponentially many configurations, yet occupies a vanishing fraction of the full space in the thermodynamic limit. Dynamics from the polarized state, by contrast, occupies a finite fraction of the configuration space, close to anticoncentration and random-state statistics, although chiral symmetry limits this fraction to one third. A weak quasiperiodic field enables the polarized state to occupy half of the configuration space by lifting the constraint imposed by chiral symmetry. The Néel state, however, requires a stronger field to reach a comparable anticoncentrated regime. As the field increases further, the occupied fraction decreases for both initial states, revealing a nonmonotonic dependence of Fock-space delocalization on field strength without necessarily implying localization.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: The paper quantifies Fock-space delocalization in PXP-model Rydberg-array dynamics by measuring what fraction of allowed configurations are occupied between revivals for polarized (scarred) versus Néel (thermalizing) initial states, finding that Néel dynamics spreads over exponentially many states but vanishingly small fractions in the thermodynamic limit, while polarized dynamics occupies a finite near-anticoncentrated fraction limited to one third by chiral symmetry but can reach about half with a weak quasiperiodic field, with both showing a nonmonotonic dependence on field strength at larger fields.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在PXP型赖登堡原子阵列的极化与Neél初态动力学中计算两次复现（revivals）之间所占据的允许构型分数来量化Fock空间的非局域化：发现Neél初态尽管在热化动力学中会遍及指数多的构型，但在热力学极限下占据的总分数趋于零；而极化初态则占据有限且接近反抗集中（anticoncentration）的构型比例，受手性对称性限制只能达到约三分之一，但可在弱准周期场下提升到约一半，且当场强进一步增大时两种初态的占据分数都会下降，呈现随场强的非单调变化而不必然意味着发生局域化。

title: Electronic-Structure-Informed Many-Body Encoding for Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: Data encoding is a central challenge in quantum machine learning (QML), as it determines how classical information is mapped onto quantum states and influences the expressive power and efficiency of parameterized quantum circuits. Here, we introduce a physics-informed quantum encoding strategy that exploits the intrinsic many-body structure of electronic systems to establish a direct correspondence between the body order of input descriptors and the locality of quantum gates. Specifically, $n$-body electronic descriptors obtained from a single mean-field electronic-structure calculation are encoded through $n$-qubit gates, yielding a systematic hierarchy of quantum circuits with increasing many-body expressivity. Using reduced-density-matrix descriptors, we construct quantum machine-learning models incorporating one- through four-body encodings and benchmark their performance in predicting electron-correlation energies along bond-stretching potential energy surfaces. We demonstrate that increasing the body order of the encoding systematically improves prediction accuracy toward the full configuration interaction limit. Remarkably, disconnected many-particle densities constructed from lower-order electronic information achieve accuracy comparable to explicitly correlated two-particle densities in key cases, providing a computationally inexpensive route to higher-body quantum encodings. These findings establish a connection between the many-body structure of classical data and the design of quantum feature maps, offering a systematic, physically interpretable framework for enhancing the expressivity and predictive performance of quantum machine-learning circuits.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a physics-informed quantum encoding that maps n-body electronic descriptors from a single mean-field calculation onto n-qubit gates to build a hierarchy of parameterized quantum circuits, showing that one- to four-body encodings using reduced-density-matrix descriptors increasingly improve electron-correlation energy predictions toward the full configuration interaction limit while achieving comparable accuracy with inexpensive disconnected densities derived from lower-order inputs.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于物理的量子编码方法，将由单一平均场电子结构计算得到的 n 体电子描述符映射到 n 量子比特门，从而构建具有层级性的参数化量子电路，并通过使用一至四体的基于简化密度矩阵的编码来预测沿键伸缩势能面上的电子相关能，结果表明编码的体阶越高预测精度越接近全组态相互作用极限，同时在关键情形下由低阶信息构造的不连通多粒子密度能够以较低计算成本达到与显式相关二粒子密度相当的精度。

title: Clifford synthesis is NP-complete
abstract: We show that the problem of synthesizing a quantum circuit for a given Clifford operator using at most a specified amount of resources is NP-complete for several resource models of practical interest. Specifically, we study synthesis of a given Clifford operator using single-qubit Clifford gates and two-qubit Clifford gates, with full qubit connectivity and no additional ancilla qubits. With single-qubit gates free and CNOT as the only two-qubit gate, we show that deciding whether a given target admits an implementation using at most a specified number of CNOT gates is NP-complete, and we show that the problem remains NP-complete when any two-qubit Clifford gate is allowed and the budget counts all such gates. Moreover, we show that both results continue to hold when SWAP gates may be inserted for free, and when single-qubit gates are also considered part of the budget. In each case, we build on recent work by Li and Guan and show that there are polynomial-time reductions from Hamiltonian path in grid graphs to these decision problems, using a number of qubits quadratic in the number of grid vertices.

summaries.en: The paper proves that synthesizing a specified Clifford operator into a quantum circuit under various realistic gate-resource budgets—covering cases with only CNOTs (or all two-qubit Clifford gates), optionally free SWAPs and/or counting single-qubit gates—is NP-complete via polynomial-time reductions from the Hamiltonian path problem on grid graphs using a quadratic number of qubits.
summaries.zh: 本文证明：在多种具有现实意义的门资源预算模型下，将给定的Clifford算符合成为量子电路的判定问题（包括仅用CNOT或允许所有两比特Clifford门、并可选地允许免费SWAP以及/或将单比特门计入预算）都是NP-complete，并通过从网格图上的哈密顿路径问题做多项式时间归约来证明，所需量子比特数与网格顶点数的平方成正比。

title: Optical Quantum Memory Processing for Quantum Hashing
abstract: Sender authentication is an important requirement for secure quantum communication networks. We propose programmable photon-echo quantum memory processing of a multi-time-bin photonic qudit for implementing a quantum-hash-based verification protocol. In this approach, using QM, sender (Alice) generates a quantum hash state by transforming a single stored photonic wave packet into the programmable photonic qudit. Bob's memory coherently maps the received time-bin photonic qudit into a single output mode according to phase encoding. Our scheme relies on a time-resolved coherent detection method introduced here, in which the coherent responses from individual time-bins are sequentially accumulated within Bob's spin coherence prior to the final sender verification. The key advantage of this coherent detection for quantum hashing is shown, and its potential applications are also discussed. The performed analysis demonstrates that experimentally verified parameters of contemporary optical quantum memories enable a proof of principle realization of the proposed architecture. These results reveal an additional role for quantum memories, serving not only as synchronization and repeater resources for long-distance quantum communication, but also as active elements for quantum hashing in conventional quantum key distribution systems.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a programmable photon-echo quantum-memory scheme that processes a multi-time-bin photonic qudit to generate and verify quantum-hash-based sender authentication using time-resolved coherent detection, showing feasibility with current optical quantum-memory parameters and suggesting quantum memories can actively support hashing in quantum key distribution.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于可编程光子回波量子存储器的方案，通过处理多时间隙光子高维量子态来生成并验证基于量子哈希的发送方身份认证，并利用新提出的时间分辨相干探测在最终验证前将各时间隙的相干响应按序累积到接收端自旋相干中，分析表明借助当代光学量子存储参数可实现概念验证，并指出量子存储不仅可作为同步与中继资源，还可作为量子密钥分发中量子哈希的主动器件。

title: Anomalous superradiant phases in a quantum Rabi zigzag chain under a synthetic gauge field
abstract: We present the phase diagram of a one-dimensional quantum Rabi zigzag chain under an artificial gauge field, which is implemented via phase-modulated next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) hopping. For a system size of $N=8$, we analytically determine the order parameters and critical thresholds, identifying five distinct superradiant phases. For strong nearest-neighbor (NN) coupling, the system exhibits either a ferro-superradiant (FSR) or an antiferro-superradiant (AFSR) phase depending on its sign. Increasing NNN coupling induces a stripe antiferro-superradiant (sAFSR) phase with antiparallel NNN and parallel NN displacements, which is distinct from the conventional AFSR phase. Tuning the magnetic flux drives the system into chiral or antichiral superradiant phases with opposite ground-state photon currents, which are different from the conventional superradiant phases. Remarkably, geometric frustration within each triangular plaquette stabilizes chiral phases even at small magnetic flux while suppressing the sAFSR phase, which vanishes for $N=6$. Mapping the system onto an effective magnetic Hamiltonian yields an analogous phase diagram featuring distinct magnetic phases, offering insight into the anomalous superradiant phases. This equivalence establishes a quantum optical platform for simulating chiral magnetism.

summaries.en: The paper maps the phase diagram of a one-dimensional quantum Rabi zigzag chain with a synthetic gauge field—implemented by phase-modulated next-nearest-neighbor hopping—showing five anomalous superradiant phases whose emergence and flux-driven chiral/antichiral behavior are governed by NN/NNN coupling and geometric frustration, with an effective magnetic Hamiltonian yielding an analogous chiral-magnetism simulation platform.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了通过相位调制的次近邻（NNN）跃迁实现合成规范场的一维量子拉比锯齿链相图，发现由最近邻/次近邻耦合及几何挫折共同主导的五种异常超辐射相，并揭示在磁通调控下出现手性/反手性的超辐射行为；同时将体系映射到有效磁性哈密顿量得到相似相图，从而为模拟手性磁性提供了量子光学平台。

title: Biorthogonal universal quantum control
abstract: As a paradigm for describing open-quantum-system dynamics, the non-Hermitian Schrödinger equation generally modifies state norms, complicating coherent control over the system's Hilbert space. With a general instantaneous frame spanned by biorthogonal ancillary bases, we develop a biorthogonal quantum-control theory for discrete-variable systems governed by time-dependent non-Hermitian Hamiltonian. In particular, we derive a necessary and sufficient condition for extracting the transitionless pathways that transport parallel in ket and bra states. When this condition is satisfied by a set of projectors constructed with biorthogonal basis states, the non-Hermitian Hamiltonian becomes diagonal in the relevant biorthogonal subspace, enabling arbitrary initial state to evolve as a superposition of controlled transitionless passages. We further identify the parametric constraints under which the transformation linking the initial and final states becomes unitary. As a result, the final system state is automatically normalized even though the transitional dynamics is nonunitary. Our theory is justified by the bidirectional population transfer and a holomonic quantum gate implemented by a non-Hermitian three-level system in $\Lambda$ type. For the population transfer, controlled gain and loss reduce the required coherent pulse area, enabling shorter transfer times than the Hermitian benchmark with the same average Rabi frequency. Our work integrates the universal quantum control (UQC) into the biorthogonal representation, displaying full-rank passage engineering with coherent operations in non-Hermitian systems.

summaries.en: The paper develops a biorthogonal universal quantum-control framework for discrete-variable systems with time-dependent non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, deriving conditions for extracting transitionless, parallel-in-ket-and-bra pathways and identifying parameter constraints that make the initial-to-final state transformation unitary and the final state automatically normalized, validated by a non-Hermitian three-level Lambda-system example for holonomic gates and bidirectional population transfer enabled by controlled gain/loss.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了将通用量子控制(UQC)并入生物正交表述的框架，用于处理由时变非厄米哈密顿量支配的离散变量量子系统，推导出在ket与bra中同时并行的过渡无关(transitionless)路径提取的充要条件，并给出使初末态变换保持幺正且最终态即使在非幺正过渡动力学下也能自动归一的参数约束，通过非厄米三能级Lambda系统的双向布居转移与全纯(holonomic)量子门实验来验证，其中受控增益/损耗降低了所需相干脉冲面积并使传输时间短于厄米基准。

title: Parametric Enhancement of an Optical Spring in a Dark Signal-Recycling Cavity
abstract: Optical springs tailor the response of precision sensors. Parametric amplification of the signal field stiffens the spring, extending the precision to higher frequencies. A Michelson interferometer operated at a dark fringe is the most direct way to separate the signal from the carrier for amplification. We experimentally demonstrate such quantum manipulation of the optical spring by placing an optical parametric amplifier in a cavity at the dark port, showing a significant increase of the optical-spring constant with the parametric gain within a factor of four below the oscillation threshold.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally shows that inserting an optical parametric amplifier into the dark port cavity of a Michelson interferometer enhances the optical spring by parametrically amplifying the signal field, increasing the optical-spring constant by up to about four times near (but below) the oscillation threshold.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在暗端口处的迈克尔逊干涉仪腔体中放置光学参量放大器，利用对信号场的参量放大来操控光学弹簧，结果在接近但低于振荡阈值的情况下使光学弹簧常数显著提升，最高约提高四倍。

title: Distilling Knowledge from Search: Decoder Model Factory for Quantum LDPC Codes
abstract: We introduce GraphMP, a learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum low-density parity-check codes that transfers without fine-tuning across code families, code sizes, physical error rates, and noise models. GraphMP uses local message passing to keep computation scalable as the decoding graph grows. Guided by its predictions, beam search progressively refines candidate error patterns, trading additional decoding time for lower logical error rates. We develop the decoder model factory as a paradigm for training successive models on experience generated by earlier models during decoding. Model-guided search supplies verified trajectories for knowledge distillation, folding computation spent on decoding into reusable training data. Repeated collection and distillation improve the decoder across generations and adapt its strategy as the noise changes. These results motivate a coupled quantum--classical architecture with two interacting cycles: rapid decoding protects quantum information, while slower learning renews the models from operating experience. The long-term vision is a scalable decoder model factory that produces high-performance, low-latency decoders and continually adapts them to evolving quantum hardware.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Disordered Systems and Neural Networks (cond-mat.dis-nn); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)

summaries.en: The paper presents GraphMP, a scalable learning-based message-passing decoder for quantum LDPC codes whose model-guided beam search and iterative distillation via a decoder model factory enable transfer across codes and noise conditions while supporting an adaptive quantum–classical architecture for continuously improving low-latency decoding.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了GraphMP，一种用于量子LDPC码的可扩展学习型消息传递译码器，通过模型引导的束搜索与基于解码经验的迭代蒸馏“译码模型工厂”机制，实现对不同码与噪声条件的无须微调迁移，并为可适应的量子—经典架构提供了持续改进低延迟译码能力的思路。

title: Analytic level statistics of the quantum Rabi model
abstract: We derive an analytic expression for the distribution of level spacings in the quantum Rabi model. At high energies, the spectrum in a fixed parity sector takes the asymptotic form of a uniformly spaced ladder modulated by a decaying oscillation. The alternating sign of this oscillation separates successive spacings into two branches. For a finite window containing many oscillations, counting how often the two branches exceed a given spacing yields an analytic expression for the spacing density at leading order. The oscillation amplitude at the lower end of the window sets the range of spacings, and its value at the upper end fixes the positions of two cusps that form twin peaks. Spacing histograms from exact diagonalization agree with the analytic density, including its spacing range and twin peak positions. At leading order, the same spectral analysis also yields an expression for the ratio of consecutive spacings, a statistic that requires no spectral unfolding. The resulting ratio statistics agree closely with those from exact diagonalization. For windows that continue to contain many oscillations, the spacing and ratio peaks move toward unity at higher energies as the spectrum approaches a uniformly spaced ladder. The same counting approach can be explored in other systems with controlled spectral asymptotics, slowly varying spacing branches, and windows containing many oscillations.

summaries.en: The paper derives analytic leading-order expressions for level-spacing and ratio statistics in the quantum Rabi model by exploiting the high-energy, parity-resolved spectrum’s uniformly spaced ladder modulated by a decaying oscillation, predicting twin peak cusps and their energies that match exact diagonalization and showing convergence toward Poisson-like unity without spectral unfolding.
summaries.zh: 论文利用量子Rabi模型在高能量、固定宇称子空间中谱呈“均匀间隔阶梯并叠加衰减振荡”的渐近结构，推导了领先阶的能级间隔与相邻间隔比的解析表达，预测由振荡符号交替导致的两支分支及在间隔直方图中出现的双峰/双凹点位置，并与精确对角化结果吻合；同时给出无需谱展开的比值统计，并表明当窗口继续包含更多振荡且能量升高时峰值向1收敛到更接近均匀阶梯的极限，且该计数思路可推广到具有可控渐近谱特性的其他系统。

title: An Unbounded Separation of Almost-Quantum and Commuting-Operator Correlations in Zero-Error Communication
abstract: Almost-quantum correlations form the $\mathtt{1+AB}$ level of the Navascués--Pironio--Acín hierarchy. They strictly contain the quantum set, are characterized by a single semidefinite program, arise in Sorkin's quantum measure theory, and satisfy several principles proposed to single out quantum theory. We show that they are nevertheless unboundedly stronger than quantum correlations in a zero-error communication task. Alice and Bob receive labels $s,t\in[N]$, $N\ge3$; after one bit from Alice, Bob must decide whether $s=t$, never erring but allowed to abstain. For every model of quantum correlations, from finite-dimensional tensor products to commuting operators, the optimal worst-case probability of a conclusive answer is exactly $1/N$, the value attained with shared randomness, so the bound does not depend on the resolution of Tsirelson's problem. An explicit family of almost-quantum correlations attains $1/19$ for every $N$. For certificates of equality from binary-outcome boxes, we solve the underlying semidefinite programs in closed form. The almost-quantum optimum equals $N^2/(17N^2-80N+64)$ for $N\ge8$ and tends to $1/17$. The first level of the hierarchy, which coincides with the set singled out by macroscopic locality, attains $N/[8(N-2)]$, which tends to $1/8$; its optimal boxes lie outside the almost-quantum set for every $N\ge5$. For longer messages, entanglement saves at most one bit over shared randomness, whereas almost-quantum correlations reduce the one-way zero-error cost of deciding equality of $n$-bit strings from $n$ bits to at most $13$. The quantum bound also yields a linear witness of post-quantumness on a face of the nonsignalling polytope.

summaries.en: The paper proves that almost-quantum correlations—though characterized by the single SDP level 1+AB of the Navascués–Pironio–Acín hierarchy and strictly containing the quantum set—can outperform all quantum correlations unboundedly in a one-way zero-error equality-decoding task, yielding an explicit family achieving probability 1/19 independent of the quantum model and larger gaps over quantum and first-level (macroscopic locality) correlations, with further implications including closed-form SDP solutions, limited entanglement advantage for longer messages, and a linear witness of post-quantumness.
summaries.zh: 论文证明：尽管几乎量子（almost-quantum）关联由NPA层级1+AB（单一SDP）刻画并严格包含量子集合，但在单向零容错的“相等性判定”通信任务中，它们能比所有量子关联出现无界优势；作者给出显式关联族可在每个N上达到1/19的成功概率，且该差距不依赖Tsirelson问题的分辨率，并进一步给出SDP的闭式解、与前一级（宏观局域性）关联的可分性、较长消息下纠缠至多节省1比特而几乎量子能把通信代价降到常数上限（≤13），以及用于非量子性的线性见证。

title: High-efficiency photonic GHZ measurements with linear optics
abstract: Probabilistic and destructive Bell-measurements, also known as fusions, constitute a fundamental primitive for photonic quantum technologies. These operations rely only on pairwise photonic interference, whereas the computational power of photonic quantum systems originates from many-body interference. Here, we introduce a family of high-efficiency linear-optical GHZ measurements based on four-mode interferometers and show that incorporating many-body interference into this ubiquitous primitive leads to more efficient entangling operations. For the four-photon case, the success probability is $9/32$, and adaptive variants ensure that unsuccessful events project onto useful stabilizer states. We further show that the approach naturally generalizes to larger GHZ measurements, yielding an exponentially higher success probability than previous linear-optical schemes. Finally, we demonstrate practical advantages for graph-state resource generation, entanglement distribution between remote spin-photon interfaces, and fusion-based quantum computing. Our results establish high-efficiency many-body measurements as a new primitive for scalable photonic quantum information processing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a family of high-efficiency linear-optical GHZ (many-body) measurements using four-mode interferometers, where adding many-body interference to standard probabilistic fusion primitives improves success probabilities (e.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一类基于四模干涉仪的高效率线性光学GHZ（多体）测量方案，通过将多体干涉引入以两光子干涉为基础的传统融合原语来提高成功概率（例如四光子情况下为9/32），并通过自适应策略使失败事件投影到有用的稳定子态；该方法还可自然推广到更大规模的GHZ测量，成功概率相较既有线性光学方案实现指数级提升，并在图态资源生成、远距离自旋-光子接口之间的纠缠分发以及基于融合的量子计算中展示实际优势，确立了高效率多体测量作为可扩展光子量子信息处理的新原语。

title: Quantum Bernstein--Kolmogorov--Arnold approximation
abstract: This paper addresses the expressivity and representation gap in Quantum Neural Networks by establishing a quantum analogue of the classical Kolmogorov--Arnold representation theorem. We propose a constructive approximation framework over fixed input coherent states, where the dependence of the function argument is embedded entirely in coordinate qubits, while the target function dictates a single outer unitary evolution. By applying a Sprecher-type representation to the rotation angle of the state, we demonstrate that the multidimensional operator factorises into \(2d+1\) commuting universal inner observables. We prove that the resulting measurement probability precisely reproduces the multidimensional Bernstein polynomial of the target function. For any continuous multivariate function, the joint quantum state converges uniformly to the target output register, linking classical superposition theory with probabilistic and coherent quantum circuits.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a constructive quantum analogue of the Kolmogorov–Arnold representation theorem for quantum neural networks, showing that with fixed input coherent states it can approximate any continuous multivariate function by encoding the input dependence in coordinate qubits, using a single outer unitary for the target function, factorizing the resulting multidimensional operator into commuting universal inner observables, and obtaining measurement probabilities that exactly match multidimensional Bernstein polynomials with uniform convergence to the desired output state.
summaries.zh: 本文为量子神经网络建立了科尔莫戈洛夫—阿诺尔德表示定理的量子类比：在固定输入相干态条件下，将输入依赖完全编码到坐标量子比特中、由仅一个外层幺正由目标函数决定，通过对态的旋转角采用 Sprecher 型表示将多维算符分解为 2d+1 个相互对易的通用内观测量，并证明测量概率精确复现目标函数的多维伯恩斯坦多项式且联合量子态对目标输出寄存器一致收敛，从而将经典叠加理论与概率性及相干量子电路联系起来。

title: Quantum machine learning geospatial time-series by seasonal encoding
abstract: Quantum data reuploading models can increase the expressive capacity of variational quantum models, but do not necessarily improve predictive performance. In the present work, we investigate this behavior for seasonal time series forecasting and show that data encoding determines how well temporal structures are represented as circuit depth increases. We develop a fidelity-based quantum geometric description in which repeated encodings contribute to an effective input generator, so that reuploading depth changes the quantum geometry through which approximately recurrent inputs are distinguished. We construct fixed and adaptive seasonal encodings that represent observation magnitude and seasonal phase in distinct Bloch-sphere coordinates. We evaluate these encodings for monthly precipitation derived from ERA5-Land, a global reanalysis dataset, from a representative semi-arid, drought-prone tropical region in East Africa, using a 14-month lag window and reuploading depths $L$= 1-6. We find that in ideal simulations, standard value-based encodings degrade markedly with depth, whereas adaptive seasonal encodings preserve temporal correlation, spectral structure, and forecasting accuracy. Noisy simulations show that this encoding hierarchy persists at shallow and intermediate depths, while larger depths are limited by circuit noise and optimization difficulty. The seasonal quantum models remain competitive with established classical forecasting methods (ARIMA, random forests, and LSTMs). These results identify structure-aware quantum data encoding as a general strategy for building deeper quantum reuploading models.

summaries.en: The paper shows that for seasonal geospatial time-series forecasting, the expressive gains of quantum data reuploading depend on the data encoding, and that adaptive seasonal encodings using distinct Bloch-sphere coordinates preserve temporal and spectral structure with increasing circuit depth—outperforming standard value-based encodings in ideal and remaining competitive under noise—while matching established classical baselines on ERA5-Land precipitation in East Africa.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，对季节性地理时序预测而言，量子数据重上传模型的表达能力提升取决于数据编码方式：采用能在布洛赫球的不同坐标中分别表示观测幅度与季节相位的自适应季节编码，能够在电路深度增加时保持时间与谱结构（相较于标准基于数值的编码在理想情况下会明显退化），在噪声仿真下该编码层级在浅层到中等深度仍成立且更深层受限于噪声与优化困难，并在东非ERA5-Land降水任务上与ARIMA、随机森林和LSTM等经典方法保持竞争力。

title: Simulating two-Dimensional decaying vortex structure with the Carleman-Lattice-Boltzmann method
abstract: We perform a numerical study of the free decay of two-dimensional nonlinear vortex structures using the second-order-truncated Carleman-Lattice Boltzmann method (CLB2). To this purpose, we simulate the nonlinear vortex system on a $128\times128$ grid at two initial Reynolds numbers, $Re\approx15$ and $Re\approx46$, by resorting to a highly-tuned multi-GPU implementation of the CLB2 code. At $Re \approx 15$, CLB2 shows significant accuracy all along the decay process, up to six diffusive times (corresponding to $950$ time steps), with structure-preserving errors below 10\% in amplitude, where by structure-preserving we imply that such errors can be almost entirely reabsorbed by a global time-dependent rescaling factor. At $Re \approx 46$, the evolution is carried out over $2850$ time steps, also corresponding to six diffusive times. In this scenario, however, the errors grow in time well above 10\% in amplitude with a still relatively modest but appreciable effect on the spatial structure of the flow. These results indicate that CLB2 is capable of preserving the nonlinear evolution of coherent structures over sufficiently long time spans to reach an effective zero steady-state. However CLB2 shows a constant sub-dissipative trend (more energy than the corresponding Lattice Boltzmann configurations) with a deteriorating accuracy at increasing time and Reynolds number. The present results shed hope that further developments, such as suitable closures instead of truncation and/or various forms of regularization, may lead to a significant improvement of the CLB2 accuracy, prior or even without escalating to expensive higher-order truncations.

summaries.en: The paper uses a highly optimized second-order truncated Carleman-Lattice-Boltzmann (CLB2) solver on a 128×128 grid to simulate the free decay of 2D nonlinear vortex structures at Reynolds numbers ~15 and ~46, finding good structure-preserving accuracy over six diffusive times at Re≈15 but growing (>10%) amplitude and spatial-structure errors at Re≈46, suggesting CLB2 can reach an effective zero steady state for longer coherence yet needs improved closures/regularization to maintain accuracy at higher Re without higher-order truncations.
summaries.zh: 论文采用高度优化的二阶截断 Carleman-Lattice Boltzmann（CLB2）方法在 128×128 网格上模拟二维非线性涡结构的自由衰减，并在雷诺数约15与约46两种情况下进行测试：在 Re≈15 时可在约六个扩散时间内保持良好的结构保真精度（幅值误差<10%且可由全局时间尺度因子基本吸收），而在 Re≈46 时误差随时间显著增大（幅值误差超过10%并对流动空间结构产生可观影响），表明 CLB2 能在足够长时间维持相干结构的非线性演化从而接近有效零稳态，但在更高 Re 下需通过合适的闭合与/或正则化等改进来提升精度，且无需显著增加更高阶截断的计算成本。

title: Extending Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization to Systems of Linear Equations
abstract: Solving systems of linear equations, $Ax=b$, is a ubiquitous task in computational science. The Harrow-Hassidim-Lloyd algorithm requires phase estimation, controlled rotations, and post-selection, impractical on noisy intermediate-scale quantum hardware. We extend sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD), developed for quantum chemistry, to linear systems. Following the sample-based Krylov variant, the Hermitian matrix $A$ is decomposed in the Pauli basis, the Trotterized time evolution of $|b\rangle$ is sampled at several times to select computational-basis configurations, and the system is solved classically by a Galerkin projection onto the selected subspace. We prove that the subspace solution is exact when the sampled configurations contain the Krylov support of $b$ and optimal in the energy norm for symmetric positive-definite matrices, so that noise-induced configurations cannot degrade it as long as they do not displace the ideal ones. On IBM Quantum hardware, the sampled distribution of a $4\times4$ example deviates from the exact one by eleven times the shot-noise level, yet the solution is recovered exactly. For a localized problem of dimension $N=1024$, SQD selects 33 configurations, reaches a relative error of $10^{-5}$, and its truncated subspaces coincide with the optimal choice; readout errors enlarge the subspace without degrading the accuracy. The tests also show the limitations: the selected subspace coincides with that of inexpensive classical selection, banded matrices require exponentially many Pauli terms in the binary encoding, and Trotter errors populate spurious configurations unless the circuits are deep. An MIT-licensed Python package and notebooks that reproduce the numerical results are provided.

summaries.en: The paper extends sample-based quantum diagonalization from quantum chemistry to solve linear systems Ax=b by sampling Trotterized evolutions in a Pauli-decomposed Krylov subspace and then classically solving via Galerkin projection, proving exactness under Krylov support conditions and optimal energy-norm performance for symmetric positive-definite matrices while demonstrating experimentally on IBM hardware that accurate solutions can be recovered even with shot-noise deviations, alongside identifying key limitations such as classical-selection equivalence, exponential Pauli-term growth for banded matrices, and Trotter-induced spurious configurations requiring deep circuits.
summaries.zh: 本文将基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）从量子化学推广到线性方程组Ax=b的求解：先将厄米矩阵A在Pauli基下分解，并对|b⟩做离散时间步的Trotter演化采样以选择计算基态配置，再在所选子空间上通过Galerkin投影进行经典求解；作者证明在采样配置包含b的Krylov支撑时子空间解是精确的，并且对对称正定矩阵可在能量范数意义下达到最优，而且只要噪声不会“位移”理想配置就不会降低精度；在IBM量子硬件上，即使4×4示例的采样分布偏离精确分布达到约11倍的散粒噪声水平，仍能恢复精确解，且对维度N=1024的局域问题SQD选取33个配置实现相对误差10^{-5}并与最优截断子空间一致，读出误差会扩大子空间但不损伤精度，同时指出局限性：所选子空间与低成本经典选择相同、二进制编码下处理带状矩阵会导致Pauli项数指数增长、且Trotter误差会产生虚假配置从而需要更深电路；文末提供MIT许可的Python包与可复现实验数值结果的notebooks。

title: A Highly Nondegenerate Photon-Pair Source for Detector-Matched Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: In a commercial entanglement-distribution system over telecom fibre, the single-photon detectors are the largest part of the hardware cost. In entanglement-based quantum key distribution (QKD), both photons of each pair must be detected. With two telecom photons, each arm needs either an InGaAs single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) of low efficiency or a superconducting nanowire single-photon detector (SNSPD) with its own cryostat. We study a highly nondegenerate photon-pair source that needs a telecom detector on one arm only. Two periodically poled KTiOPO$_4$ (ppKTP) crystals pumped at 405~nm emit pairs at 548 and 1550~nm. A Si-SPAD with 82\% efficiency detects the 548~nm photon at the source node, and only the 1550~nm photon travels through fibre. A first, unoptimised module in a polarisation-correlated configuration generates about $1.5\times10^6$ pairs/s per mW of pump power. It collects 13\% of the pairs on the 548~nm arm and 23\% on the 1550~nm arm. In an asymptotic BBM92 model, we compare its links with generic $2\times1550$~nm links that use a bright published source at the same pump power. At 50~km, our link with one SNSPD costs about 25\% more per secret bit than the generic link with one SNSPD. With optimistic target values of 52\% collection and twice the brightness, it costs about 40\% as much as the generic link with two SNSPDs. Our link without a cryostat then costs about 70\% less than the generic link with one SNSPD. If every link runs at its own best pump power, the two-SNSPD link is again the cheapest. The source can also serve clock synchronisation and detector calibration, which need only time-correlated pairs. All key rates assume the entangled configuration of the source, which is under development.

summaries.en: The paper presents a highly nondegenerate photon-pair source using two ppKTP crystals that directs only the 1550 nm photon through telecom fibre while detecting the 548 nm photon locally with a Si-SPAD, and it evaluates how this architecture affects QKD link cost and secret-bit rates compared with conventional two-1550 nm systems using SNSPDs.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种高度非简并的光子对源：用两块ppKTP晶体产生548 nm与1550 nm光子对，并仅让1550 nm光子通过电信光纤而在源端用Si-SPAD探测548 nm光子，从而在BBM92模型中与常规双1550 nm系统（采用SNSPD）比较链路成本与每秘密比特速率，并指出该光源也可用于时钟同步与探测器校准（需时间相关但不必纠缠）。

title: Scaling laws of entanglement entropy in fractal dimensions
abstract: Entanglement entropy scaling links geometry to quantum correlations and diagnoses quantum criticality. Fractal lattices extend this link to noninteger dimensions, where boundary and bulk dimensions are independent. It remains open which dimension governs entropy scaling and how strongly gap closing can enhance it. Nonlocal occupied-state projectors and the lack of translation symmetry obstruct standard methods. We overcome these obstacles and classify free-fermion entropy scaling with bounds set by the hopping across the subsystem boundary: an upper bound from its rank and the spectral gap, and a lower bound from how much it lowers the ground-state energy. With only negative-energy states filled and this energy lowering proportional to the boundary, the entanglement entropy obeys the boundary law $S_X=\Theta\left(L_X^{d_{\mathrm b}}\right)$ under a uniform gap and satisfies $L_X^{d_{\mathrm b}}\lesssim S_X\lesssim L_X^{d_{\mathrm b}}\ln L_X$ when the gap closes no faster than algebraically. Here $L_X$ is the subsystem linear size and $d_{\mathrm b}$ the boundary dimension. Half occupation of the chiral zero modes gives a mixed-state entropy $S_X^{\mathrm{mix}}$ with $\max\left\{S_X,z_X\ln2\right\}\leqslant S_X^{\mathrm{mix}}\leqslant S_X+z_X\ln2$, where $z_X$ is the local zero-mode weight; an extensive $z_X$ thus makes $S_X^{\mathrm{mix}}$ follow the bulk dimension.

summaries.en: The paper determines scaling laws for free-fermion entanglement entropy on fractal lattices with independent bulk and boundary dimensions, showing it obeys a boundary-law scaling set by boundary-hopping under a finite gap and acquires at most logarithmic enhancements when the gap closes algebraically, with additional mixed-state contributions from chiral zero modes tied to their local zero-mode weight.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了在具有独立的体维度与边界维度的分形晶格上自由费米体系的纠缠熵缩放规律，表明在有限能隙下纠缠熵由跨越子系统边界的跃迁决定并满足边界定律，若能隙按幂律关闭则最多出现对数增强；同时，手性零模带来的混合态纠缠熵由局域零模权重控制，并可随之遵循体维度。

title: Bounding Fidelity of Non-Stabilizer States from Local Pauli Measurements
abstract: Nonstabilizerness, commonly referred to as magic, is essential for universal quantum computation. Yet, for pure $n$-qubit states this property is directly linked to the hardness of direct fidelity estimation. We propose a scheme to bound the fidelity on non-stabilizer states by choosing operators with low measurement overhead and using parallel local Pauli measurements to estimate compatible observables. We selectively measure operators that share a permutational symmetry without imposing any assumption on the physical system. This selection reduces the optimization to a linear program with only $O(n)$ variables for bounding fidelity. Our methods can be extended to bound nonlinear quantities like the purity via convex quadratic programs. For hypergraph states that can exhibit extensive nonstabilizerness, we demonstrate for up to $n=500$ qubits that our framework substantially reduces the measurement overhead under both local and global depolarizing noise. These results show that symmetry induced by measurement selection reduces both measurement and computational costs, enabling scalable characterization of magic resources in quantum computing and quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper presents a symmetry-based, low-overhead protocol that uses parallel local Pauli measurements and an O(n)-variable linear program (and convex quadratic programs for nonlinear quantities) to bound the fidelity of non-stabilizer (magic) pure states without assumptions on the physical system, demonstrating large reductions in measurement cost for hypergraph states up to 500 qubits under depolarizing noise.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于对称性的低开销方案，利用并行的局域 Pauli 测量与仅需 O(n) 个变量的线性规划（以及用于非线性量的凸二次规划），在不对物理系统作任何假设的情况下对非稳定子（魔性）纯态的保真度进行界定，并在 500 个量子比特范围内的超图态中、在退极化噪声下展示显著降低的测量成本。

title: Overcoming the Representational Limitations of Amplitude Encoding for Quantum Neural Networks
abstract: Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) offer a framework for learning functions from classical data, but their expressive power depends critically on how inputs are encoded into quantum states. Angle encoding can require resources that scale with the number of features, whereas amplitude encoding represents $d$ features using only $\mathcal{O}(\log_2 d)$ qubits. This compactness comes at a representational cost: normalization makes conventional amplitude encoding invariant to nonzero real rescaling of the input, up to an unobservable global phase. We show that this invariance induces an exact, architecture-independent restriction on the resulting hypothesis class. No downstream quantum circuit can distinguish inputs differing by nonzero real scaling. We develop a general condition under which deterministic preprocessing can remove this ambiguity and show that nonlinearity alone is insufficient. Based on this analysis, we introduce a fixed nonlinear feature map that provably distinguishes all real inputs under subsequent amplitude encoding, without adding trainable parameters and while retaining logarithmic qubit scaling. We evaluate the resulting QNN on three canonical classification benchmarks and a nonlinear synthetic dataset against conventional amplitude and angle encoding, as well as a classical neural network. Across these tasks, the proposed encoding consistently improves classification accuracy over both quantum encoding baselines by 21$-$44 %. Our results establish normalization-induced scale invariance as a concrete representational bottleneck of amplitude encoding and demonstrate that it can be removed while preserving a compact quantum representation, marking a step toward quantum models capable of capturing arbitrary relationships in classical data.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Emerging Technologies (cs.ET); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Optimization and Control (math.OC)

summaries.en: The paper shows that amplitude-encoded quantum neural networks are inherently scale-invariant due to state normalization, imposes an architecture-independent limitation on the hypothesis class, and introduces a fixed nonlinear preprocessing feature map that removes this ambiguity while preserving logarithmic qubit scaling, yielding 21–44% higher classification accuracy on several benchmarks than conventional amplitude/angle encoding and comparable classical baselines.
summaries.zh: 该论文证明幅度编码量子神经网络因状态归一化而固有地具有实数缩放不变性，从而对假设类施加架构无关的表示性限制，并提出一种固定的非线性特征映射以在保持对数级量子比特规模的同时消除该歧义，最终在多个基准任务上相较传统幅度/角度编码获得21–44%的分类精度提升。

title: Control-Noise Trade-offs in Industrially Integrated ${}^{28}\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiGe}$ Spin-1/2 Qubits
abstract: Scaling silicon spin qubits to fault-tolerant processors requires semiconductor foundry integration, yet it remains unclear how industrial fabrication and dense device integration affect qubit control and noise. Here we study ${}^{28}\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiGe}$ electron spin-1/2 qubits fabricated using Intel's industry-compatible 300 mm process and incorporating micromagnets for electrically driven spin resonance, using a high-performance device fabricated in the RIKEN research cleanroom as a reference. Primitive $\pi/2$-gate fidelities reach the 99.99% level in the Intel devices, which also exhibit longer idle coherence, weaker low-frequency correlations and reduced qubit-to-qubit variability across several measured characteristics. In the present Intel devices, the micromagnets are integrated inline with the back-end-of-line (BEOL) contact routing, with their separation from the quantum well set through the vertical stack design. Relative to the reference, their larger separation contributes to weaker longitudinal and transverse magnetic-field gradients. The weaker longitudinal gradient suppresses the conversion of charge noise into qubit-frequency fluctuations, whereas the weaker transverse gradient reduces electrically driven spin-resonance efficiency and makes drive-dependent errors relevant at lower Rabi frequencies. Additional BEOL routing and metal levels required for two-dimensional arrays make such placement decisions increasingly consequential when scaling. These results establish an integration-level control-noise trade-off linking micromagnet placement within densely routed layouts to achievable gate performance, while very high-fidelity operation remains possible in industrially fabricated devices.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: The paper compares Intel-fabricated 300 mm ${}^{28}\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiGe}$ spin-1/2 qubits with a RIKEN cleanroom reference and finds that industrial integration yields ~99.
summaries.zh: 论文对采用英特尔300毫米工艺制造的${}^{28}\mathrm{Si}/\mathrm{SiGe}$自旋1/2量子比特与RIKEN洁净室参考器件进行对比，发现工业化集成可实现约99.

title: Benchmarking Single-Photon Sources for Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution
abstract: Measurement-Device-Independent Quantum Key Distribution (MDI-QKD) enables secure communication without trusting the measurement devices, but its performance critically depends on the quality of the employed photon sources. We compare MDI-QKD implementations based on Weak Coherent Pulses (WCPs) with those employing Quantum Dot (QD) single-photon sources. WCP-based schemes are fundamentally limited by Poissonian photon-number statistics, imposing a trade-off between single- and multi-photon emissions, whereas QD sources exhibit sub-Poissonian statistics with low antibunching parameter $g^{(2)}(0)$. Using a decoy-state analysis for both source types, we find that even at moderate mean photon numbers, QD-based implementations outperform the best-case WCP configuration - where the mean photon number is optimised at each transmission distance - across the full range of transmission distances. We further incorporate the effect of imperfect photon indistinguishability via Hong-Ou-Mandel interference visibilities into the security framework and demonstrate that both source types are highly sensitive to even small deviations from ideal indistinguishability, significantly affecting achievable key rates and maximum transmission distance.

summaries.en: The paper benchmarks measurement-device-independent QKD using weak coherent pulses versus quantum-dot single-photon sources and finds that, under decoy-state analysis, sub-Poissonian QD sources with low antibunching outperform optimally tuned WCP schemes for all transmission distances while Hong–Ou–Mandel–based modeling shows that small imperfections in photon indistinguishability strongly reduce key rates and maximum distance for both implementations.
summaries.zh: 本文对比弱相干脉冲与量子点单光子源两种测量设备无关量子密钥分发方案，在分离态（decoy-state）分析下发现，具有低反聚束参数的亚泊松量子点源在全部传输距离上都优于在每段距离最优调节平均光子数的最优弱相干脉冲方案；同时将基于洪-奥-曼（Hong–Ou–Mandel）干涉可区分性（相同性）不理想性纳入安全性框架，结果表明两类方案对理想不可区分性的轻微偏离都高度敏感，显著降低可实现密钥率和最大传输距离。

title: Topologically Protected Edge States in a Single Flux Qubit
abstract: We show that topological edge states can be realized in a simple superconducting circuit composed of an inductively shunted flux qubit. The Josephson potential of that qubit forms a honeycomb lattice similar to the case of graphene. The additional shunting element produces a quartic potential along one flux direction, which effectively creates a boundary in flux space. We map analytically the low-energy dynamics of the circuit to an extended Su--Schrieffer--Heeger (SSH) chain, in which a quartic potential is added to the usual SSH Hamiltonian. This mapping is confirmed by numerical simulations of the full superconducting circuit. We argue that chiral symmetry still holds for the edge states of the extended model around a chiral point in parameter space. Close to this point, we numerically find that edge states in our superconducting circuit are topologically protected against perturbations that obey chiral symmetry, as is the case for charge noise. Our results show that topological effects previously thought to occur in multi-qubit systems, such as protection against decoherence, can also be found in much simpler single superconducting qubits.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall)

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that a single inductively shunted flux qubit can host topologically protected edge states by mapping its honeycomb-like Josephson potential with an added quartic boundary term onto an extended Su–Schrieffer–Heeger chain, supported by analytic mapping and numerical simulations showing chiral-symmetry-protected robustness to relevant perturbations such as charge noise.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，一个由电感分流的单个通量量子比特即可实现拓扑保护的边缘态：其类石墨烯的约瑟夫森势并通过在一个通量方向加入四次势形成“边界”，可被解析映射为带有四次项的扩展 Su–Schrieffer–Heeger（SSH）链，并通过对完整超导电路的数值模拟验证，在参数空间的手性点附近证实边缘态仍受手性对称性保护，能抵抗诸如电荷噪声这类满足手性对称的扰动，从而表明此前认为仅在多量子比特系统中出现的抗退相干等拓扑效应也可在更简单的单个超导量子比特中实现。

title: Secret-shared teleportation of a two-qudit gate with a deferred recipient
abstract: An unknown quantum operation, like an unknown quantum state, cannot be perfectly copied or stored for later use. A specific gate can be embedded in an entangled resource and teleported, but its destination is fixed when the resource is created. Here we show that the capability to apply a two-qudit entangling gate can instead be secret-shared among many parties: the shares are distributed in advance, and a later key release lets exactly one of them, chosen after distribution, exercise it. A provider encrypts half of a Bell pair held with a user into $n$ shares, one per candidate node. The selected node, given the key qudits, completes an exact non-local $\mathtt{CSUM}^{k}$ gate with the user's data, in every measurement branch and for any qudit dimension, with the power $k$ chosen by the user alone. Any coalition of fewer than $n$ candidate nodes, or the key register alone, holds no information, unselected nodes cannot tell whether a selection occurred, and the key cannot decrypt twice. For two candidates the registers form a $((3,5))$ threshold scheme. Encoder and decoder are explicit $O(n)$ circuits. The construction supports jointly authorized and anonymous gate application, advancing distributed quantum computing and quantum network capabilities.

summaries.en: The paper presents a secret-shared, deferred-recipient protocol for teleporting an unknown two-qudit entangling operation so that after distributing encrypted shares in advance, a user-controlled key release lets a post-selected node (among candidates) apply an exact nonlocal CSUM^k gate with perfect security and threshold properties, with explicit O(n) circuits for encoding and decoding.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种用于推迟接收者的两量子比特维（qudit）纠缠门秘密共享传送方案：在预先分发加密份额后，待用户释放密钥时即可让在事后选择的候选节点执行精确的非局域 CSUM^k 门，并保证任意少于阈值的共谋者或密钥寄存器本身都不泄露信息、未被选中的节点无法判断是否完成选择且密钥不能被重复解密，且给出了明确的 O(n) 编码与解码电路并支持联合授权与匿名门应用。

title: Characteristics of VHF and UHF band detection using Stark shifting in Rydberg-atom sensors
abstract: We present a characterization of the sensitivity of broadband electric field measurements in the Very High Frequency (VHF) and Ultra High Frequency (UHF) bands using AC stark shifting of Rydberg states. The dependence of the sensitivity and dynamic range of the field measurements using nD5/2 states of cesium for principal quantum numbers n= 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100 is presented, detailing the intricacies involved. The frequencies considered for the measurement range from 50 MHz to 900 MHz for which a transverse electromagnetic (TEM) cell is used to excite the Rydberg atoms with the RF fields. The corresponding sensitivities achieved are in the $(\mu V/m)/\sqrt{Hz}$ range. A general trend of better sensitivity for higher principal quantum numbers is observed. This work paves the way for a better understanding of the AC Stark dependent field measurements using Rydberg sensors.

summaries.en: The paper characterizes how Rydberg-atom sensors using AC Stark shifts of cesium nD5/2 states (n=60–100) measure broadband electric fields from 50–900 MHz, reporting sensitivities in the (μV/m)/√Hz range in a TEM-cell setup and finding improved sensitivity at higher principal quantum numbers.
summaries.zh: 论文通过利用铯原子 nD5/2 态在 n=60–100 的 AC Stark 移动，实现了在 50–900 MHz 范围内的宽带电场测量灵敏度表征（TEM 腔激励里德伯原子），给出了约（μV/m）/√Hz 量级的灵敏度结果，并观察到随主量子数增大灵敏度提升的总体趋势。

title: Switching off a high-harmonic polarization channel by anti-unitary symmetry
abstract: We study polarization-resolved high-harmonic generation in a laser-driven two-leg Su--Schrieffer--Heeger ladder with asymmetric dimerization under periodic boundary conditions. A field linearly polarized along the ladder can generate both longitudinal and transverse radiation, whose harmonic content is controlled by lattice symmetry and electronic filling. Using symmetry analysis of the time-dependent density matrix, we show that reflection symmetry enforces odd-order harmonics in the longitudinal response and, when the transverse response is nonzero, even-order harmonics in the transverse direction. At half filling, an additional anti-unitary symmetry relating the occupied and empty bands suppresses the transverse current completely. A unitary chiral symmetry in the clean ladder relates the same bands but fails to enforce this cancellation, showing that band swapping alone is insufficient: the suppression requires both a density-matrix constraint that persists during the driven evolution and the appropriate transformation of the transverse-current operator. Moving away from half filling lifts this cancellation and allows transverse emission, while the reflection selection rule remains whenever reflection symmetry is preserved. Numerical calculations at quarter and half filling, combined with onsite potentials that selectively break the relevant symmetries, confirm these two distinct mechanisms. Thus, reflection symmetry determines which harmonic orders occur, whereas the interplay of anti-unitary symmetry and filling controls whether the transverse HHG channel is present at all.

summaries.en: In a two-leg Su–Schrieffer–Heeger ladder, symmetry analysis of the time-dependent density matrix shows that reflection symmetry fixes longitudinal odd-order and (when present) transverse even-order high-harmonic generation, while at half filling an additional anti-unitary symmetry completely suppresses the transverse HHG channel—a cancellation that requires both a persistent density-matrix constraint and the correct transformation of the transverse-current operator, not merely band swapping, and is lifted away from half filling or when the relevant symmetries are selectively broken numerically.
summaries.zh: 在具有非对称二聚化的两腿Su–Schrieffer–Heeger梯形中，通过对时间依赖密度矩阵的对称性分析可知：反射对称性决定纵向响应的高次谐波仅出现奇数阶、并在横向响应不为零时使横向出现偶数阶；而在半填充时，额外的反幺（anti-unitary）对称性会将横向高次谐波完全淬灭，这种抵消必须同时满足在驱动演化中持续存在的密度矩阵约束以及横向电流算符的正确变换，而仅靠能带互换并不足够；数值计算并结合选择性破缺相关对称性的在位势，验证了该纵向/横向两种不同机制，并表明当偏离半填充或破坏相应对称性时该横向发射会恢复，而反射选择规则只要保留反射对称性就仍然成立。
